what_was_adopted: The design as declared, in full and unamended: T4E.24's 60 configurations at S = 6 with identical geometry, replanted on the same backgrounds from the same record frames under root seed 20260911, with the family-wise level alpha swept over the four declared values 0.05, 0.10, 0.25 and 0.50, the cut taken from the scene, and 999 surrogates throughout. The five reported quantities, the declared prediction and its falsification condition, and the five acceptance conditions are adopted exactly as written.
the_concern_raised_before_adoption_and_h: It was put to the maintainer that the prediction is close to derivable from the steepness of an extreme-value tail, and that deriving it would be cheaper than running it. The maintainer adopted the slice anyway. The declaration's own answer stands as the reason: the DIRECTION is arguable from the tail's shape, but the SIZE of the effect at these four particular alphas is not, and the three derivable-and-underived lessons in this programme all began with an argument standing in for a measurement. The run is therefore not a confirmation of arithmetic; the arithmetic does not supply the numbers being asked for.
the_sweep_is_exactly_paired_and_this_is_: Because only the cut varies, one surrogate ensemble per scene supplies every threshold in the sweep: calibration_from_maxima takes the same order statistic over the same maxima at a different alpha, which is exactly what calibrate does internally. So the four alphas are not four runs to be compared, they are four cuts through one measurement, and no difference between them can be a sampling difference. It also means the sweep costs what a single run costs, and that the alpha = 0.05 baseline reproduces T4E.24 by construction rather than by luck -- which is what makes acceptance condition 2 a real check on the wiring rather than a formality.
the_framing_is_adopted_as_binding_not_as: The cut is working as declared. Alpha is the probability that a structureless field yields ANY reported feature, because the statistic is the maximum over the frame -- a documented, deliberate choice made so that a reported feature means something a reader can act on. A family-wise bar over 25,921 cells is severe by construction and a faint feature failing it is the control operating as specified. This slice measures what that control costs. Any write-up that presents the result as a defect in the extractor, or as grounds for having found one, breaches this adoption.
what_this_adoption_does_not_do: It selects no alpha, recommends none, and authorises no change to the default. Choosing an operating point against a measured trade-off is a separate declaration owing its own blindness claim, and R20 forbids the horse race -- a swept diagnostic is not a selection procedure and must not become one. It authorises no change to local_maximum_extractor, to NullCalibration, or to the frame-maximum statistic, and no replacement for any of them. It re-measures no identity criterion and supersedes neither T4E.24 nor T4E.13.
the_swept_list_is_closed: 0.05, 0.10, 0.25 and 0.50, fixed before any number exists. No value may be added, removed or substituted after the measurement, and a value whose gate fails is reported as excluded by name rather than dropped. Adding a fifth alpha once the curve is visible would be fitting the sweep to its own answer.
what_is_not_opened_by_this: Reserved seeds 720-735 and 880-895 stay closed and the 2022-2023 forecast-test period stays unopened. The slice replants T4E.24's own scenes and needs none of them.
the_evidence_is_already_inspected_and_st: T4E.24's scenes are development evidence, inspected on 2026-09-11. Replanting them under a different cut does not make them fresh, and no result from this slice is confirmatory evidence for anything.
cross_domain: R19 applies. A frame-maximum family-wise cut over a large grid is severe wherever it is applied and NullCalibration runs identically in every domain this repository serves, so the obligation transfers. The curve does not: these values belong to 850 hPa relative vorticity over this crop under this planting and are quoted for no other domain.
scope_adopted: Atmospheric identity path only, on synthetic evidence with known truth.
governing: Declare the prediction, and the design's strongest objection to itself, before the measurement. Both are in the adopted declaration and neither may be revised after the numbers exist.
A named refusal is preferable to an unsupported number.
Evaluate the candidate alone; no horse race (R20).
If no step in the declared range separates coverage from contamination, that is the result and is reported as such -- acceptance condition 5 is a permission to return nothing, not a failure state.
If the alpha = 0.05 baseline does not reproduce T4E.24, that discrepancy is reported before anything else and the rest of the sweep is not interpreted until it is explained.
Nothing here approves a mining radius, discharges T4E.8's acquired-record acceptance, or closes D96, D97, D98, D99 or D100. The primary scientific target remains kind_recurrence.
claim_boundary: Carried unchanged from the declaration: this measures a property of one detection scheme on synthetic evidence with known truth, across four declared levels. It settles nothing about the atmosphere, nothing about any real cyclone, and nothing about whether any identity criterion is correct. It licenses no operating point. It bears on the partial-recurrence criterion only by establishing whether the coverage T4E.24 measured is specific to alpha = 0.05 or is a property of the scheme across a declared range.
